explanation: The prophet who conveys God's message to King David in 2 Samuel 7.
The second king of Israel and a central figure in 2 Samuel, known for his piety and military skill.
A holy place dedicated to God, where worship and sacrifices take place. In this context, it refers to the temple David wishes to build for God.
An agreement or promise between two parties, in this case between God and David. God promises to establish David's kingdom and his descendants as rulers over Israel.
The term refers to a time of peace and stability for Israel, which God promises David and his people after they have been delivered from their enemies.
Symbolizes royal power and authority. In 2 Samuel 7, God promises that David's throne will be established forever.
A person who comes from a specific lineage or family. God promises that one of David's descendants will rule over Israel and establish an eternal kingdom.
